steps.label: Ton entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat me_v4_aa me_v4_ab > mixe.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q mixe.tgz)" = 2143f06d5de349cef166d529ddbcf824 ] && rm -f mix_full.m4a && tar xzf mixe.tgz

steps.label: Ton anlegen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out3.mp4 -i mix_full.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest peloton_film3b.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i peloton_film3b.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 26 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy peloton_film3b_vorschau.mp4 && ls -la peloton_film3b*.mp4
